en.hubeali: H 14914 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Qasim Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Muhammad Al-Qasany, from Suleyman Bin Dawood, from Hammaad Bin Isa, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws having said:

‘Luqman<sup>as</sup> advised his<sup>as</sup> son: ‘O my<sup>as</sup> son! Travel with your sword, and your slippers, and your turban, and your tent, and your water container, and your needle, and your threads, and your shoe-repair kit, and your provision of medicines which are beneficial for you and the one is with you. And be in concordance with your companion except if it is in the disobedience to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 467. Ali, from his father, from Al-Nowfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.), from his forefathers (a.s.) having said: ‘The Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘It is from the nobility of the man that he would have good provisions when he goes out on a journey’.
